title: Why Sean Payton ordered a life-sized cardboard cutout of OC Davis Webb to Broncos camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Sean Payton ordered a life-sized cardboard cutout of OC Davis Webb to Broncos camp
sources.description: The Broncos' offense will still have plenty of Payton's ethos in the Super Bowl-winning coach's fourth year at Denver's helm. But expect it also to reflect the flavor of Webb, an up-and-coming coach.
